title: Someone Who Got There First
description:
An investment seminar. The presenter stepped up.

"Hi, I'm Lee Minseo. I started in a Gangnam jeonse apartment [rented deposit-only] at 35, and now I own the place outright. I'm 38."

[Jeonse: Korea's unique deposit-only rental system. Instead of monthly rent, you pay a large lump-sum (often ₩100M-500M+) that sits with the landlord. No monthly payments. At lease end, you get the full deposit back. It's how many Koreans 'step into' expensive areas without buying.]

Started at 35. Goal reached at 38. Three years.

{name} ran the numbers. That timeline is almost identical to his.

choices.text: Get her business card after the talk — want to ask how
choices.result_text:
Lee Minseo smiled and handed over her card.

A handshake with someone who owns a Gangnam apartment. Slightly unreal. And — she was once standing where {name} is standing.

choices.text: Just listened and left — no nerve to approach
choices.result_text:
On the way home, her words kept running through his head.

Not 'it can be done' — but 'she already did it.' That stayed longer than expected.

title: Beyond Gangnam
description:
Ran into Lee Minseo at a café near the seminar venue. Different face than on stage.

"Oh — you were at the seminar, weren't you?"

Coffee together. She said things she didn't say at the talk.

"Honestly — I got more exhausted after buying the apartment. There's the mortgage. Kids' tutoring costs. And even though the price went up, I can't sell — I live there."

Got Gangnam — and Gangnam got her.

choices.text: "But you achieved the goal." — see the positive
choices.result_text:
Lee Minseo smiled briefly. "Yes. I did achieve it."

But that smile was different somehow. {name} wanted to understand the difference. Probably have to get there to know.

choices.text: "Is there something I'm not seeing? Tell me honestly." — ask directly
choices.result_text:
She thought for a moment, then said:
"When you have a goal — you have to be ready for when the goal disappears. That's the hardest part."

It took {name} a while to understand what that meant.

title: The One Who Arrives
description:
Gangnam wasn't far now.

With the number nearly full, a message came from Lee Minseo.
"I heard. They say you're almost there."

They met again at that same cafe.
"Congratulations. I mean it."
Then she went quiet for a moment.
"Remember what I told you back then?"

{name} remembered. 'When you have a goal, prepare for when it disappears.'
Now — he was starting to understand what she meant.

choices.text: "I think I'm starting to get it." — said it honestly
choices.result_text:
Lee Minseo nodded.
"Right? When you arrive, the next question comes. 'So now what.'
But that's not all bad. At least — it's a new question."

For the first time, {name} felt that Gangnam wasn't the end, but the start of the next sentence.

choices.text: "I haven't arrived yet. Don't want to count my chickens." — smiled
choices.result_text:
Lee Minseo laughed. "Fair enough. See it all the way through."

Still, {name} decided to tuck her words away in his bag.
He'd take them out once he got there.
